transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling customer service. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi, I'm calling because there is a charge from a hotel on my account that really shouldn't be on there.
Agent: I can look into that for you. May I have your full name and your billing zip code first?
Customer: My name is Yusra Haddad, and the zip code is 97201.
Agent: Thank you, Ms. Haddad. Which charge are you looking at, and how much was it for?
Customer: It's from Lakeview Suites for $460.00. I saw it on my September 18, 2026 statement.
Agent: All right, I see that entry. It looks like the transaction itself happened on September 8th. Could you walk me through what took place?
Customer: Sure. I had booked a stay there, but my trip ended up getting called off, so I contacted them to cancel.
Agent: Did you cancel directly with the hotel or through a third-party travel site?
Customer: I called Lakeview Suites directly. It was well within their free-cancellation window, so there wasn't supposed to be any penalty.
Agent: When did you speak with them to cancel?
Customer: That was three weeks ago. The representative I spoke to gave me a cancellation code and told me the money would be sent back to my card.
Agent: Do you have that cancellation code with you?
Customer: Yes, I wrote it down. It is LV-44910.
Agent: Did they mention how long it would take for the funds to return?
Customer: They told me it would show up within three to five business days, but three weeks have passed now and nothing has appeared on my account.
Agent: Have you reached back out to Lakeview Suites since then to follow up?
Customer: I called their front desk a couple of days ago, but nobody seemed to know what was going on, and they just put me on hold until I gave up.
Agent: Just to make sure I have all the facts down: you have a $460.00 charge from Lakeview Suites from September 8th on your September 18, 2026 statement, you cancelled inside their free window about three weeks ago, received cancellation number LV-44910, and were told you would get the money back, but it hasn't arrived.
Customer: Yes, that is completely accurate.
